## Task

What were you trying to check?

## Minimal public reproduction

Provide a tiny directory tree, ignore rules, selected context, and selected Dockerfile. Remove private paths, secrets, and proprietary code. Do not upload your entire project.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include the relevant rule line and file state. Mention whether rules were saved or a draft, and whether scanning was partial.

## Environment

OS / architecture, VS Code version, extension version. If you compared with Docker, include its version and exact command.
